text:
maria-sales: Heads-up — AcmeHealth POC just advanced to procurement. They want a 12-month reserved commit but need a reliable capacity plan for throughput and SLA. Can SE/infra estimate GPUs and autoscale policy we should propose?
kevin-se: Congrats! Quick Q: primary workload is chat completions (multi-turn) with avg 512 tokens/input, peak 350 rps, latency SLO 300ms p50 and 700ms p95. Is that the number we should size for?
eli-eng: Yep those numbers look right from their load tests. For the model they want to use a 13B open model quantized to int8. On A100-80GB we saw ~45-60 rps per GPU for p95 under similar seq lengths.
tanya-cs: They expect ~3x peak headroom for business hours and burst to 5x for campaigns. Also security team flagged VPC + KMS + SOC2; procurement wants us to include private deployment option in quote.
kevin-se: Rough calc: peak 350 rps / 50 rps per GPU ≈ 7 GPUs baseline. Add 3x headroom => reserve 21 GPUs? That seems high. Could we recommend reserved 8 GPUs + autoscale to 24 with burst?
eli-eng: I would recommend reserved commit for baseline 10 VMs (each VM 1xA100) with autoscale policy up to 24 GPUs. Autoscale: scale out when util > 65% for 90s, scale in when util < 35% for 5m, and keep burst pool cold-warm to avoid cold-start latency. Also enable prefix/KV cache for conversation hot paths — reduces effective GPU load ~20%.
maria-sales: Pricing check: customer is targeting $250k/month commit. Does reserved 10 GPUs + autoscale match that band?
kevin-se: Ballpark: reserved A100 capacity (10 GPUs) + support + console + private infra add-on ≈ $180–220k/mo. Autoscale usage beyond reserved billed at overage rates — should fit inside $250k with some headroom; we can model usage with expected burst hours. I can run a billing sim if you want.
tanya-cs: Security blockers: they need an updated SSP, evidence of network isolation, and KMS integration details. I've attached checklist in the procurement ticket. For Private deployment we need to confirm on-prem packaging timeline — could add 6–8 weeks.
eli-eng: POC tasks: (1) run canonical perf run using their sample convo set (500 concurrent sessions, 512 tokens avg) — here's a quick perf cmd we use: ```rbench --model r13b-int8 --concurrency 500 --avg_tokens 512 --report p50,p95``` Collect token/s and latency hist. (2) Enable KV cache and rerun to estimate delta. (3) Produce sizing + cost deck for sales.
maria-sales: Perfect. Kevin — can you own the billing sim and draft the reserved vs autoscale quote? Eli/Tanya please coordinate POC test windows with AcmeHealth this week. I'll prep the procurement email and include the timeline and assumptions. :thumbsup:
autoscale-bot: Autoscale suggestion saved: target_util=65% scale_up_delay=90 scale_down_delay=300 max_instances=24 min_instances=10
kevin-se: Will do, I can deliver the cost sim by EOD tomorrow. Also flagging that if they choose H100 we can cut GPUs by ~30% but list price changes. I'll include that scenario.
tanya-cs: I'll attach the SSP and KMS integration doc to the ticket and ask security for expedited review. If they need SOC2 evidence, we can provide the report within 48 hours.
maria-sales: Thanks team — syncing with customer 9am PT tomorrow. We'll use the numbers in this thread for the call unless anything fundamentally changes. :calendar:
